gaps.what: Dates and manner of the Archbishops' acquisition of the Moselle towns between Trier and Koblenz (Wittlich, Cochem, Zell, Bernkastel, Saarburg, Oberwesel), Montabaur and the Limburg share; the 1333 gain is a confidence-1 bridging entry
Date of elevation to an electorate (page gives only 'between 1189 and 1212'); end of the 1684-1697 French occupations
Limits of the county before 1329 (whether Besançon, Salins, Montbéliard, Belfort belonged); the end of the 1237 Salins seigneurie; no war of 1333-1384 appears on the pages
Swedish occupation of 1642-1650: end of the occupation outside Leipzig (1648, confidence 1) and the 1645 truce are undated
Cliopatria changes of 1564, 1579, 1588 and 1803, and seven cells missing from the 1746-1805 shapes against 1648, are not dated by any page; Vogtland, Henneberg and Mansfeld not dated
Extents of Saxe-Weissenfels, Saxe-Merseburg and Saxe-Zeitz are circles around the towns the pages name (the pages give no area or boundary)

problems: electorate-of-trier: six pages opened against a budget of five (the Baldwin of Luxembourg page had no territorial facts).

electorate-of-trier: all ten Cliopatria shapes (1333..1618) are a misplaced block (about 49 cells in Bavaria, 21 in the Hunsrück-Nahe country, none at Trier or Koblenz); the Cliopatria row should not be drawn. holy-roman-empire-minor-states logs a 1431 loss of 25 cells to it that is moot with the corrected shape.

electorate-of-trier and free-county-of-burgundy: both dossiers run beyond Cliopatria (Trier 898-1803; Free County 982-1384), so their new early keyframes overlap Cliopatria's Holy Roman Empire Minor States and Kingdom of Arles shapes; a renderer must give these dossiers priority there.

free-county-of-burgundy and county-of-artois: the pages put Artois and the County of Burgundy in one hand from 1329 but county-of-artois ends 1332 per Cliopatria, so Artois is drawn twice in 1329-1332.
electorate-of-saxony: Cliopatria draws the Wettin electorate for 1429-1486 in its House of Ascania row; this dossier carries new keyframes 1423-1486, so those Ascania shapes must not be drawn.

electorate-of-saxony: Cliopatria shapes 1640, 1642, 1645 (drop Lusatia and the Dresden-Meissen swath) and 1683 (cuts 12 cells) are marked wrong; the three secundogeniture duchies are modelled as separate states and need dossiers.

electorate-of-saxony and archbishopric-of-magdeburg: the Peace of Prague and Saxe-Weissenfels pages date Saxony's gain of Jüterbog, Dahme, Burg and Querfurt to 1635; the Magdeburg dossier dates Jüterbog's passing to Saxony to 1648.
Counterparts prum-abbey, nassau-weilburg, saxe-weissenfels, saxe-merseburg and saxe-zeitz have no dossier yet (validator warnings only).
electorate-of-trier resolves with 17 warnings for the places Boppard, Prüm and Montabaur until the gazetteer agent adds them.
